contentPattern.structure: 3-up borderless icon/stat tiles (image-only; labels may be baked into icon images)

suitableFor: 3-across spec / stat icon bands (e.g. Aircraft Variant / Program of Record / Industry partnerships)
centered borderless icon rows on partner-country and about pages
notSuitableFor: bordered news/article teaser grids with dates and read-more links (use cards-news)
milestone item grids with year label + description (use cards-milestone)
